---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

An analysis of video game completion times from HowLongToBeat.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load the downloaded HowLongToBeat data
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Plot main story hours versus completionist hours
games |>
  filter(!is.na(main_story_hours), !is.na(completionist_hours), completionist_hours < 250, main_story_hours < 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = main_story_hours, y = completionist_hours)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred") +
  labs(
    title = "Main Story vs. Completionist Duration",
    subtitle = "Top 1,000 popular games on HowLongToBeat",
    x = "Main Story (Hours)",
    y = "100% Completionist (Hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
